A '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] six [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the battle, the [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] of [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] located a weak point in the Confederacy's battle line and raided the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] that housed the Confederacy's central computer, temporarily shutting down their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and giving the [[121st Regiment]] [[Time/Legends|time]] to push past the enemy's heavy artillery.<ref name="Galaxy" />
